name: 10ms
philosophy: limit is the brief, not a wall
CPU is gold; waiting on fetch/KV/D1 is free

layers.rule: edit machine, AI translates to human, never edit human directly, conflict: machine wins

is: quality kept, work moved off hot path
is_not: runtime available on every platform today

story.voice: community: 'One of us', 'Our ceiling'. never first person
beats: 2006: elevator crash in Vancouver, programmer climbs 21 floors, refuses to call it normal, starts Rust (named after a fungus built to survive)
2026: One of us builds Vionsky (social AI, CF Pages Worker). request passes 10ms CPU, Error 1102. advice: add framework, pay bigger plan
Our ceiling: free tier, tiny budget, slow phone, team of one. same move: refuse to call it a wall
question: what would we build if the limit were the brief?
story.closing_vi: Giới hạn không phải bức tường, mà là nơi chúng ta bắt đầu.

steps: run: git clone, npx wrangler dev index.js (1 min)
contribute.measure: deployed Worker, Free plan ok, Workers Logs CPU per invocation; if not deployable, say how measured

keep_verbatim: README demo index.js (<60 lines, WHY comments)

decisions.why: Workers Free = 10ms CPU; limit filters useless work
Hono 14KB is a safe default; 10ms = smaller, zero waste; respect, not clone
hidden = no community; copy cannot copy community, story, trust, speed
any AI reads it in one go; ecosystem grows outside core
AI context is limited; STATE = now, LOG = history
all AIs read English best; keep it simple
min tokens for AI; one source of truth; story for community
limit killed the previous merge mid-way; max loss = 1 step
